company.name: MakeMeLook.ai
company.shortDescription: Create unique looks in seconds and feel like a celebrity
company.description:
We are a team of tech and fashion entrepreneurs who set out to create an innovative product by taking the best of offline shopping, interacting with stylists and combine with cutting edge AI technology.

We are creating MakeMeLook.ai to save up to 10 hours a week on fitting, searching and selecting items, giving you the ability to create images and try them on your exact digital copy in seconds.
